privacy.audit: App/Sources use private JSON/file storage, user-selected file imports, local audio and local hinge observations; no network client, advertising/analytics SDK, microphone, permissions or remote catalogue. CC0 assets are audio resources, not third-party executable SDKs. No direct listed required-reason APIs in application sources: no UserDefaults, boot-uptime/mach_absolute_time, file timestamp/disk capacity or keyboard enumeration. ContinuousClock only measures local intervals. Archive manifests/linkage will be inspected after export.

qa.basis: 41 core tests; 13 hosted player/model tests plus full UI suite. iPhone/iPad 18/0/1 and Duo 19/0/0 on unchanged App/Sources. Recorded imports and previews validate decode, bounds, persistence, missing hinge, route/lifecycle cancellation, active-state and explicit labels. Static accessibility labels/IDs and actual UI captures inspected. No claim of physical output, human listening or full assistive-technology certification.
